VICTORINOX BRAND HERITAGE

Originators of the Swiss Army Knife Victorinox have been producing their multi-functional tools for the Swiss Army since 1884. A family company with a strong focus on tradition and innovation, they strive to produce quality tools and cooking products ready to solve modern problems, while retaining their enduring design and lifetime warranty.

DELIVERY & RETURNS

Order before 2pm 7 days a week for same day dispatch on all Express and Next Day orders, including engraved and embossed orders.

 

Delivery:

FREE standard delivery on orders over £100 or choose from Express or Next Day fully tracked delivery or pick up from our Cheltenham Showroom.  All orders placed before 2pm are dispatched on the same day 7 days a week.  View our full Delivery Policy.

 

Our Packaging:

All of our packaging is plastic free and can be recycled or composted at home. Our outer packaging is made from 70% recycled card and over 98% of our inner packaging is made of repurposed card on site. For more information please visit our recycling pledge page. 

 

60 Day Returns

Select from Free collection or drop off at your local Post Office. On engraved orders we are confident that you will be delighted with the quality of the engraving however should you wish to return we can offer a full credit or exchange.  View our full Returns Policy
